sections.title: ⚠️ THE REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI guesses based on common causes. If wrong, it traps you in an apology death loop. **Always verify:** Ask for theories, not a single blind fix.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**Global View:** Systematic isolation and resolution of system failures.
**The Motivation:** Stop guessing. Use the scientific method to prove or disprove root causes without wiping your environment.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
**Prerequisites:**
- Full Error Logs
- Version info (OS/Framework)
- Git History (what changed last?)

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'I am getting this error: [X]. Here is the code and the last change I made.'*

steps.label: Failure
steps.content: AI gives a command that wipes current state.

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'List the top 3 likely root causes. Do not give me a fix yet.'*

steps.label: Failure
steps.content: AI hallucinates a non-existent config flag.

steps.label: The Fix
steps.content: Verify flag existence in official documentation.

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'How can I run a test to confirm Hypothesis 1 without changing production code?'*

steps.label: Guardrails
steps.content: Snapshot your environment before applying any AI-suggested 'patches'.

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'Hypothesis 2 was correct. Give me the patch and explain the prevention.'*

steps.label: Expected
steps.content: A permanent fix and a new automated test to prevent regression.

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS & TESTS
sections.content: **Validation:** Never paste the same error back to AI twice. If it failed the first time, change the context. Use `bisect` logic manually to narrow down the breaking change before involving the AI.

sections.title: 🔭 NEXT STEPS
sections.content:
**Future Learning:** Master `Wireshark` and `strace` for deep system forensics.
**Links:** SRE handbook at `sre.google`.
